name: blocks
title: Blocks
description: A ball, a bar and a smaller ball stacked like toy blocks wobble into balance. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `Blocks`. Import it from `@/components/ui/blocks` and render `<Blocks key={run} aria-label="Toy blocks wobbling into balance" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--blocks-surface`, `--blocks-shape`, `--blocks-shade`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: no motion; the stack shows its resting state.
